Project requirements:

- Implement user authentication with JWT tokens and refresh token rotation
- Create RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on all entities
- Set up database migrations with version control and rollback capabilities
- Configure CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and deployment
- Add comprehensive logging and monitoring with alerting system
- Implement rate limiting and DDoS protection at the API gateway level
